change_log.summary: 从当前正式workbench机械迁移稳定task_id、路线动作、步骤与几何；玩家备注/地图悬浮标签/时间模型分别归属Task Presentation、UI、Timing。
Stage 5: split Task 13125 quest transport as Scourgeholme -> Echo Valley return visit before turn-in; verified Task Card identifies the Ebon Watcher in Echo Valley as both giver and turn-in.

Semantic-parity correction for Task 13082: accepting the Boon of Adal transports Shattrath -> Dalaran; then hearth to Shadow Vault; then fly to Silent Vigil. Added an explicit Dalaran visit with null coordinates rather than fabricating a landing point. Sources: local Task Card 13082 plus WotLK Wowhead/DB confirmation that accepting the quest casts Portal Effect: Dalaran.

Semantic-parity cleanup: removed 10 reviewed legacy special location.transport hints in Icecrown. Each hint describes an outgoing player action or UI style at the point (bind hearth, taxi, quest/fixed transport), not the arrival edge. Explicit player actions remain unchanged; unproven arrivals stay unresolved.

Reclassified the Dalaran intermediate state in Task 13082 as transition_context: it preserves the confirmed Shattrath -> Dalaran quest transport ordering but is not a required map navigation point. Exact landing coordinates are therefore not required. The post-Dalaran return-to-Icecrown operation remains separately tracked in the final human decision ledger instead of being upgraded to user-verified fact.
